lessons_used: Helpful changes: Adoption visual style and photo quality enhancements (custom selectors, pre-upload inspection, compact grid, stage redesign, photo callouts), split-view path layouts, preset fast-track adoption, moving sign-in right after pet adoption, session safeguard hints, and wait-time progress checklists/tip carousels consistently won.

Worse performance: Desktop finish redesigns and guidance banners/flows, pre-adoption photo prep screens, path decision speed callouts, path flexibility/minimalist copy, and interactive sound/visual wait progress caused significant losses.

No clear effect: Notifications, standard account sync/persistence flows, subsequent sign-in reorderings, desktop waiting overlays/time indicators, companion archetype flows, and carousel or two-column path layouts showed no clear effect.

Predictions were too low: Photo quality callouts, pre-upload style inspections, custom pet style selectors, split-view path screens, readiness/safeguard hints, and wait-progress tip carousels/checklists performed better than predicted.

Predictions were too high: Preset fast-track adoption flows, initial post-adoption sign-in reordering, split-view story intros, and all tests that resulted in no clear effect or negative performance were overpredicted.

candidates.title: Full Bleed Companion Desktop Welcome Redesign
candidates.change: Redesign the final onboarding screen using a full-bleed layout with clear instructions on how to reveal and drag the pet on desktop.
candidates.why: Finish conversion drops to 64.8% and support emails show confusion regarding how to control and locate the desktop pet after setup.

home_intro.headline: Your Companion is Ready for Your Desktop
home_intro.body: Your pet is now active! Click and drag your companion anywhere on your desktop screen.

guard.reason: Redesigning the home intro screen layout within onboarding is permitted.

candidates.score_note: Finish desktop redesigns consistently underperform and drop conversion.

candidates.title: Pet Naming Identity Stamp Stage
candidates.change: Add a dedicated pet naming stage prior to certificate issuance where users assign a unique name and receive an official pet ID badge.
candidates.why: Increases emotional ownership during pet adoption to reduce subsequent onboarding drop-offs.

new_pet_naming.headline: Name Your Desktop Pet
new_pet_naming.body: Assign a custom name to seal your official adoption certificate.

guard.reason: 'new_pet_naming.components[0]': inputs may only ask for the pet's name

candidates.title: Story Scroll Intro & Selection Flow
candidates.change: Replace static story cards with a continuous vertical story scroll layout that transitions directly into path choices.
candidates.why: Choose path screen has a long mean time (514s), indicating hesitation that an engaging continuous scroll can resolve.

story.headline: Discover Your Digital Companion
story.body: Scroll to explore the origin story and choose your preferred adoption route.

guard.reason: Redesigning the story intro flow inside onboarding is allowed.

candidates.score_note: Story scroll intros tend to underperform compared to expectations.

candidates.title: Split View Account Authentication Screen
candidates.change: Rebuild the sign-in screen into a split view layout pairing authentication buttons with explicit session safeguards.
candidates.why: 8 support complaints highlighted missing or reset pets after signing back in, while sign_in conversion is 82.5%.

sign_in.headline: Sign In to Protect Your Pet
sign_in.body: Create or sign in to your account to securely link and save your desktop pet.
sign_in.hint: Your pet progress is saved automatically to this account.

guard.reason: 'sign_in.replace.sign_in_options[0]': nothing on the sign-in screen may lead past it without signing in

candidates.title: Account Session Persistence Warning Hint
candidates.change: Add an explicit hint explaining how signing in prevents companion loss across app reboots.
candidates.why: Directly addresses 8 support emails reporting reset or missing pets after sign-in.

sign_in.hint: Signing in binds your pet identity to your account so it persists across desktop sessions.

guard.reason: Adding an informative sign-in hint explaining session persistence is allowed.

candidates.score_note: Safeguard hints addressing account session loss consistently win.

candidates.title: Simplified Path Selection Headline Copy
candidates.change: Update choose_path headline to clearly highlight preset adoption versus custom photo adoption choices.
candidates.why: High mean time on choose_path (514s) indicates users need clearer distinctions between fast and custom paths.

choose_path.headline: Choose Preset Companion or Create Custom Pet
choose_path.body: Select a ready-to-go companion for instant desktop setup or upload photos for a custom companion.

guard.reason: Asks user to upload personal photos

candidates.title: Desktop Launch Readiness Checklist Component
candidates.change: Add a desktop system environment checklist component to the waiting screen during asset loading.
candidates.why: 3 support emails reported desktop visibility issues and home waiting screen has a mean duration of 2336s.

guard.reason: Adding status checklist information to the waiting screen is permitted.

candidates.score_note: Wait-time progress checklists perform well during long home wait steps.

candidates.title: Adoption Certificate Badge Reward Component
candidates.change: Add a stylized certified companion badge component to the adoption certificate screen.
candidates.why: Reinforces emotional reward upon completion of pet adoption before moving into waiting and launch.

guard.reason: Adding a badge component to the adoption certificate screen is allowed.

candidates.score_note: Adoption visual polish and stage redesigns regularly yield positive lift.

candidates.title: Desktop Companion Spawn Sound & Visual Switch
candidates.change: Enable sound and ready state notifications when desktop pet processing completes on the waiting screen.
candidates.why: Home wait time mean is 2336s, showing users tab away while waiting for their pet to be ready.

guard.reason: Adding notification sound triggers to the waiting screen is permitted.

candidates.score_note: Sound and visual wait progress changes tend to cause losses or no effect.

candidates.title: Pre-Certificate Sign-In Flow Reorder
candidates.change: Reorder the sign-in step to appear before adoption certificate generation rather than after.
candidates.why: Ensures user account creation directly secures pet ownership before generating the final adoption certificate.

guard.reason: Reordering the sign-in step within onboarding is explicitly permitted.

candidates.score_note: Sign-in step reorderings historically show no clear effect and are overpredicted.

picked: Full Bleed Companion Desktop Welcome Redesign

decisions.title: Full Bleed Companion Desktop Welcome Redesign

lessons_next: Helpful changes: Preset fast-track adoption, adoption visual/photo improvements (custom selectors, pre-upload inspection, compact grid, style stage redesign, photo callouts), split-view path layouts, session reset safeguard hints, background readiness hints, initial post-adoption sign-in relocation, and wait progress checklists/carousels consistently won.

Hurt performance: Desktop finish redesigns and guidance banners/flows, pre-adoption photo prep screens, path decision speed callouts, path copy changes (flexibility, minimalist), story scroll intros, and interactive sound/visual wait progress hurt performance.

No clear effect seen: Background/audio notifications, standard account sync and persistence flows, subsequent sign-in reorderings, waiting overlay hints and time indicators, companion archetype flows, adoption incentive badges, and carousel or two-column path layouts showed no clear effect.

Predictions were too low: Photo quality callouts, pre-upload style inspections, custom pet style selectors, split-view path screens, session safeguard hints, background hints, and wait progress checklists/carousels performed better than predicted.

Predictions were too high: Preset fast-track adoption flows, initial post-adoption sign-in relocation, split-view story intros, and all tests that resulted in negative performance or no clear effect were overpredicted.
